question: Are A21's remaining shifted-target losses mainly due to F/G covariance sharing or to source calibration of risk adaptation under a compatible-source-only pool?
basis: A21 completes all160 paths and numerical controls. Shared-source target gain versus same-pool I/R has a positive nominal interval, but four other learned-prior strata have negative mean gains versus I/R. High-frequency and support-mismatch scores are coherently lower than old per-archive A12. The latter contrast also changes source calibration, so it cannot be assigned to F/G alone.
accounting: Keep A20's issued q fixed and move all F/G prior mass back to I. F/G effect is actual A21 minus this same-q I/R score. Joint-q effect is same-q I/R minus the same-source-pool I/R control. Source-pool calibration effect is same-source-pool I/R minus old per-archive A12. These three effects sum exactly to A21-minus-A12. Also retain the two removal-order-averaged F/G effects from the existing A18 accounting function; do not fit or select any weights.
summaries: Retain all160 paths and steps9-24. Average within each path and pair16 seeds separately in each of five regimes and both prior arms. Report the same issued q values, same-pool I/R q and old A12 q, as well as pure F/G/R gains and posterior macro mass at steps9/24. Nominal paired intervals remain descriptive development evidence, not new independent confirmation.
controls: Align saved seed/regime/arm/step/candidate identities. Reconstruct every saved A21 score from its branch densities and prior, verify total and F/G accounting identities, and confirm generic duplicate F/G contribute zero. Any discrepancy prevents attributing the loss.
decision: Identify the causal modeling assumption requiring a new source-only test. Retain A20/A21's mixed and negative results; no target-selected q, floor, winning branch or recommendation replay. Freeze any changed calibration as a new version and test it on source archives before another target test.
limitations: This is exact frozen-predictor score accounting, not a causal intervention on new query paths. Same-pool I/R and old A12 use different amounts and structures of historical source information. Accounting cannot establish which alternative calibration would generalize or create source examples of target shifts.
